articleTitle: Modeling of the Power Losses and the Efficiency of a 21 MVA Superconducting Transformer
publicationTitle: 2018 Conference on Electrotechnology: Processes, Models, Control and Computer Science (EPMCCS)
abstract: The study involves a computer model of a single-phase conventional as well as a superconducting transformer with the power of 21 MVA, developed in the PSpice program. In this model, a magnetic core made of ET114-27 Stalprodukt steel sheets is adopted, described by Jiles-Atherton level two equations. The study determines the load dependence of the losses in the iron and windings of a conventional transformer, the losses in the iron, windings and structural elements of the superconducting transformer, as well as the total losses in both types of 21 MVA transformers. Depending on the load, the efficiency of these transformers is also determined.

articleTitle: Application of Fuzzy Cognitive Maps to Multi-Step Ahead Prediction of Electricity Consumption
publicationTitle: 2018 Conference on Electrotechnology: Processes, Models, Control and Computer Science (EPMCCS)
abstract: This paper is devoted to the multi-step ahead prediction of multivariate time series with the use of fuzzy cognitive maps. The aim of the analysis is to predict the electricity consumption in a household. The learning process was performed with the developed Structure Optimization Genetic Algorithm (SOGA). A comparison with the well-known method for fuzzy cognitive maps learning: the Real-Coded Genetic Algorithm was done. The obtained results show that the SOGA algorithm enables simplifying the fuzzy cognitive map by selection of the most significant concepts and connections and forecasting the three next steps of electricity consumption with satisfactory accuracy.

articleTitle: Semi-Industrial Laboratory Setup for Measuring and Control of Humidity of Moving Cotton Band Dried by Induction-Heated Rotating Steel Cylinder
publicationTitle: 2018 Conference on Electrotechnology: Processes, Models, Control and Computer Science (EPMCCS)
abstract: The article presents a description of a semi-industrial system for temperature and humidity control of a cotton fabric ribbon using an induction-heated rotating cylinder. The system consists of a main drying cylinder and system of 9 rolls providing the required lead and tension of a cotton band. Such a system enables to moisten, humidity measurement and dryness control of the cotton ribbon.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Influence of Material Parameters on Efficiency of Switched Reluctance Motor
publicationTitle: 2018 Conference on Electrotechnology: Processes, Models, Control and Computer Science (EPMCCS)
abstract: The paper deals with analysis of an influence of rotor magnetic materials on the efficiency of switched reluctance motor. Considered were composites, electrical sheets and ferrite. The characteristics inductance and losses as a function of the rotation angle for these materials were presented and compared. For identification of the parameters of the switched reluctance motor, a test bench was constructed. Parameters of electric motor as a function of rotor rotation angle were identified. The equivalent resistance and inductance of the motor as a function of the rotor rotation angle was determined. The least squares method was used to determine the parameters. To measure the efficiency of the reluctance motor, the test bench was constructed. This test bench consist of also a torque sensor and an additional motor as a load.

articleTitle: Human Emotions Recognition with the Use of Speech Signal of Polish Language
publicationTitle: 2018 Conference on Electrotechnology: Processes, Models, Control and Computer Science (EPMCCS)
abstract: Human emotions recognition is very important for developing the human-computer interaction systems. Known approaches, dealing with that issue, use such methods as k-nearest neighbours algorithm, support vector machine, decision trees or hidden Markov models. In this article the authors propose the use of spectrograms of Polish emotional speech as an input for artificial neural network (ANN) to classify the emotions of human. Obtained results show that proposed method has good classification efficiency which reaches the value of 75% or more. The influence of the spectrogram subfields on classification efficiency has been analysed.

articleTitle: Approval of Special Warning Lights for the Power-Driven Vehicles in Free Market
publicationTitle: 2018 Conference on Electrotechnology: Processes, Models, Control and Computer Science (EPMCCS)
abstract: The paper presents the legal acts, that is, UNECE Regulations and the European Union directives specyfying the requirements to be met by the special warning lights mounted in vehicles. In particular, it deals with the scope and research methods of the warning light devices mounted in the vehicles in compliance with the requirements of the UNECE Regulation no. 65 (“Uniform regulations concerning the approval of special warning lights for the power-driven vehicles and their trailers.”).

articleTitle: Susceptibility of the LLC Resonance Generator for Induction Heating on Changes in Load Parameters Caused by Heating the Charge
publicationTitle: 2018 Conference on Electrotechnology: Processes, Models, Control and Computer Science (EPMCCS)
abstract: In the induction heating processes, there are usually large changes of the impedance of the inductor-charge system. They may be caused by a change in the using inductor-charge system, but also result from the charge heating process itself, which is related to the change of its electrical material parameters. Particularly the latter cause, related to the dynamics of the heating process and the type of charge materials, is difficult to correct and may lead to large restrictions on the use of the potentially available power of the power source, which is usually a resonance inverter. Using a simulation package taking into account the interactive cooperation of the source and calculated by the finite-element method inductor-charge system, the sensitivity of inverters with series, parallel and LLC resonance on changes in load parameters caused by process of the charge heating have been compared. For the LLC generator, it was analyzed whether through the selection of its parameters, one can influence the limitation of sensitivity to load change, and thus improve the possibility of better use of the potentially available power of source.

articleTitle: Dryness Control of a Moving Cotton Ribbon by Induction Heating of Rotating Steel Cylinder
publicationTitle: 2018 Conference on Electrotechnology: Processes, Models, Control and Computer Science (EPMCCS)
abstract: The article presents an introductory attempt to build a dryness control system for automatic drying of moving materials (like paper or cotton ribbon) using an induction heated rotating steel cylinder. The main goal of this work is to test and verify the recently developed semi-industrial laboratory setup comprising, apart from heated cylinder, also a system for carrying a cotton ribbon, together with moistening devices based on electromagnetic injectors and a contactless microwave moisture meter. Several experiments have been performed and a basic dryness control system has been built and evaluated.

articleTitle: Investigation and Determination of Efficiency of the Waste Heat Recovery System Using Peltier Modules
publicationTitle: 2018 Conference on Electrotechnology: Processes, Models, Control and Computer Science (EPMCCS)
abstract: High efficiency technology of waste heat energy utilization would change the face of the energy market. Due to the fact that the energy system and transport are based on fossil fuels, there is a huge potential for its efficient use. Despite the fact that the technology of Peltier semiconductor modules has been known for many years, there are no solutions that might be commonly disseminated. There is also a deficit of available sources that in a transparent, coherent and synthetic way could provide guidelines for the constructors of such devices, and show how much energy they can generate and what efficiency they have. Moreover, the Peltier modules available on the market are burdened with many stereotypes. When trying to use this technology, it should be remembered that in addition to the Peltier phenomenon, the module's operation is based on four other physical phenomena: two of them have a negative impact and they determine the practically obtained parameters of the Peltier module. These are: Joule effect and heat conduction phenomenon. The other two phenomena: Seebeck and Thomson ones, play slightly smaller roles. The aim of the authors was to investigate the self-made model of a thermoelectric generator TEG, constructed using Peltier modules. The paper presents the results of measurements and the method of determining the electrical efficiency of this model. Additionally, a temperature range was determined at that such recovery has a measurable utilitarian aspect and economic sense. The limitations of semiconductor technology of Peltier cells have been given, and design guidelines at construction process of such systems to optimize their efficiency are presented.

articleTitle: The Risk of Thermal Damage to the HTS Transformer”s Coils During the Inrush Current
publicationTitle: 2018 Conference on Electrotechnology: Processes, Models, Control and Computer Science (EPMCCS)
abstract: The inrush current of superconductor transformers can repeatedly exceed the critical current of the high-temperature second-generation superconducting tapes from which their windings are made. The study analyses the temperature rise of the HTS transformer's primary voltage windings during the inrush current. The analysis was made on the basis of tests of superconducting transformers with the power of 8.5 kV A and 13.8 kV A supplemented with a numerical evaluation performed in the Matlab program.

articleTitle: Modeling of Single-Phase AC Circuit with Nonlinear Load and Power Measurement Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 Conference on Electrotechnology: Processes, Models, Control and Computer Science (EPMCCS)
abstract: The paper deals with a model and results of simulation of AC circuit with nonlinear load. The definitions of reactive power of Budeanu, IEEE and proportional to the product of voltage and current time derivative are discussed. Comparison of these definitions was carried out for a simple circuit consisting of inductance and nonlinear load connected in series, powered from a sinusoidal AC source. The analytical solution of the equations of this circuit is considered, taking into account all harmonics. Then a model of this circuit was worked out and a simulation was carried out. On the basis of the waveforms in the steady state, the powers for individual definitions in the time domain and in the frequency domain were determined. The results of calculations in both domains are very similar and consistent with the results of earlier theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Higher Harmonics and Power in Circuits with LED Light Sources
publicationTitle: 2018 Conference on Electrotechnology: Processes, Models, Control and Computer Science (EPMCCS)
abstract: The paper deals with a power measurement methods and higher harmonics in circuit with LED light sources. The laws on the electric power quality in Poland has been presented. Current and voltage waveforms are analysed. The frequency spectrum of the current circuit is presented. The coefficients of power quality were determined and reference to the standard. The powers in the circuit with LED lamps were calculated and analysed.

articleTitle: Equivalent Diagram of Bridge Rectifier in a Circuit with Inductance
publicationTitle: 2018 Conference on Electrotechnology: Processes, Models, Control and Computer Science (EPMCCS)
abstract: The paper deals with an equivalent diagram of bridge rectifier with RC load. The bridge rectifier is supplied from sinusoidal voltage source through series inductance and resistance. The analytical equations of circuit were given. The equivalent linear diagram of the analysed nonlinear load was formulated. The values of the diagram elements were analysed as a function of the RC load. The active and reactive power distribution on the circuit elements was analysed.

articleTitle: Relationship Between Asymmetrical Distribution of the Magnets and Cogging Torque of BLDC Motor with External Rotor
publicationTitle: 2018 Conference on Electrotechnology: Processes, Models, Control and Computer Science (EPMCCS)
abstract: This paper presents the issues of the cogging torque and its reduction methods in permanent magnet motors. In the paper the most common methods of minimizing cogging torque, information about used materials and calculation methods on the example of an electric motor with external rotor, one of the method, were presented.

articleTitle: An Efficient Storage Management for SD2DS
publicationTitle: 2018 Conference on Electrotechnology: Processes, Models, Control and Computer Science (EPMCCS)
abstract: The paper presents Scalable Distributed Two-layer Data Structure (SD2DS) used for building a scalable distributed datastore. It focuses on the management of the second layer of SD2DS. Three different strategies for management of buckets with free space are compared and analyzed. Two different implementations of SD2DS were prepared for performing experiments. Results coming from both implementations are combined for getting the most reliable results, which are presented in the paper. They are used to evaluate the proposed strategies.

articleTitle: Improvements of Hybrid Models of the Electric Arc of Variable Geometrical Parameters
publicationTitle: 2018 Conference on Electrotechnology: Processes, Models, Control and Computer Science (EPMCCS)
abstract: The paper suggests some improvements of mathematical models of the electric arc with variable geometrical parameters. To this end, various hybrid models with dynamically variable arc length and cross-section area are considered. Dissipated power is treated analogously as in the Mayr and Cassie models as terms activated by a weight function. Besides, it is taken into account that heat dissipation increases in the high-current range. In the modifications of hybrid models proposed in this paper, parameters are dependent on momentary conductance. Effectiveness of so modified models was subsequently tested in simulations.

articleTitle: Short Circuits in the Power System and the Location of the Faults on the Example of the Seismic-Acoustic Method
publicationTitle: 2018 Conference on Electrotechnology: Processes, Models, Control and Computer Science (EPMCCS)
abstract: The paper presents the causes and effects of formation short-circuits and methods of classification location short-circuits of cable lines. The algorithm for dealing with the fault location of the cable line was discussed. Also included is a method to precise location of the fault where has been the most widely discussed seismic-acoustic method.

articleTitle: Identification of Parameters of Inertial Models Using the Levenberg-Marquardt Method
publicationTitle: 2018 Conference on Electrotechnology: Processes, Models, Control and Computer Science (EPMCCS)
abstract: The paper presents a proposition of a method for identification of parameters of selected inertial models using the Levenberg-Marquardt algorithm. The influence of measurement disturbances on the quality of identification was presented. The described method was compared with other applied identification methods.

articleTitle: Maintenance Policy for Multistate Electrical Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 Conference on Electrotechnology: Processes, Models, Control and Computer Science (EPMCCS)
abstract: Optimization of preventive maintenance strategies usually requires identifying the reliability of the object. For multistate devices, various models describing the process of changing the states of these devices can be used. The paper presents a mathematical model of preventive maintenance for multi-state complex technical objects based on the theory of semi-Markov processes.

articleTitle: Numerical Determination of Equivalent Resistivity for an Automotive Catalyst with a Steel Core
publicationTitle: 2018 Conference on Electrotechnology: Processes, Models, Control and Computer Science (EPMCCS)
abstract: The article describes the method of determination of equivalent resistivity for an automotive catalyst with a steel core. To determine the equivalent resistivity, a three-dimensional calculation model of the catalytic converter fragment was prepared. For such adopted model, electrical conduction analysis was carried out. Based on solution of the model first resistance, and then resistivity was calculated. Calculations were carried out with use of GetDP program.

articleTitle: The Efficiency Analysis of Stirling Engine with Linear Generator Used in CHP Unit
publicationTitle: 2018 Conference on Electrotechnology: Processes, Models, Control and Computer Science (EPMCCS)
abstract: The aim of this paper is to present the possibilities of combined heat and power (CHP) using a Stirling engine with a linear generator. The laboratory tests of the CHP system with Stirling Engine were made, a control and measurement system was created, allowing to determine the most important electrical parameters. On the basis of the tests conducted, the obtained power of the linear generator, thermal power and system efficiency were determined. Computer simulations of the built-in control measurement system in the LabViewsoftware were performed and a magnetic flux in a linear generator made in the Finite Elements Method Magnetic program. The study can be used to develop a cheap and easy-to-manufacture a cogeneration system with the Stirling engine and to extend the use of alternative fuels to power the Stirling engine in public utility buildings.

articleTitle: Influence of Harmonic Filters on the Operation of AC Arc Furnace Power Installation
publicationTitle: 2018 Conference on Electrotechnology: Processes, Models, Control and Computer Science (EPMCCS)
abstract: AC arc furnaces are electric energy receivers with chaotic consumption of non-sinusoidal currents, especially in the first phase of steel melting. Due to current distortions and their inductive nature, passive harmonic filters, SVC reactive power compensation systems and active filters are used in arc furnace installations. The paper presents the parameters of electric power quality in installations of arc furnaces. The spectrum of harmonics and THD indices for voltages and currents on the medium voltage side for two operating modes-on and off state-of passive filters were calculated using Fast Fourier Transform on the basis of computer-recorded measurement data. The damping coefficients for voltage harmonics and the gain coefficients for current harmonics were determined. Graphs of P, Q and S power are shown for the harmonic filters on and off.

articleTitle: Design for Self-Adaptivity of Real-Time Embedded Systems Using Developmental Genetic Programming
publicationTitle: 2018 Conference on Electrotechnology: Processes, Models, Control and Computer Science (EPMCCS)
abstract: This paper presents a method of synthesis of self-adaptable real-time embedded systems. The method assumes that the system specification is given as a task graph. Then, tasks are scheduled on distributed architecture consisting of low-power and high-performance processors. We apply the developmental genetic programming to generate the self-adaptive scheduler and the initial schedule. The initial schedule is optimized taking into consideration the cost, the power consumption, the real-time constraints as well as the self-adaptivity. The scheduler modifies the schedule, during the system execution, whenever execution time of the recently finished task occurred other than assumed during initial scheduling. The goal of rescheduling is to minimize the power consumption while all time constraints are satisfied. We present some experimental results for standard benchmarks, showing advantages of our method in comparison with worst case design used in existing approaches.

articleTitle: Cooperation of the AC/DC/AC Power Converterwith a GlidArc Multi-Electrode Plasma Reactor
publicationTitle: 2018 Conference on Electrotechnology: Processes, Models, Control and Computer Science (EPMCCS)
abstract: The paper analyses the cooperation of the GlidArc plasma reactor powered directly from the AC/DC/AC power converter in a special version, and the cooperation of the converter with intermediary transformers between the converter and the reactor. The results of the research throw light on the properties of multi-electrode plasma reactor with gliding arc discharge, fed from electronic multiphase energy source with adjustable parameters of current, voltage and frequency and the problems of cooperation of both devices. Methods of solving the problems encountered are also provided.

articleTitle: Bending of Tubes Heated Locally by a Laser Beam
publicationTitle: 2018 Conference on Electrotechnology: Processes, Models, Control and Computer Science (EPMCCS)
abstract: The process of tube bending assisted by laser beam is presented. The elastic self-straightening after removing of the bending moment is analysed. The theoretically calculated values of the bending force are compared with the results of experimental tests.

articleTitle: Impact of Database Connection Security on Response Time: Case Study
publicationTitle: 2018 Conference on Electrotechnology: Processes, Models, Control and Computer Science (EPMCCS)
abstract: Developing even simple applications connected to server may require a lot of work due to the need to monitor server performance. In the case of a growing database and an increasing number of connections, an inadequately configured server-physical or virtual-may cause delays or even disconnection. Therefore, this can significantly degrade the user experience and even discourage users from continuing to use the application. On the contrary striving to accelerate the operation of services is not conducive to maintaining and taming the level of security. The choice between a faster and less secure solution, and one that provides stability but at the same time introduces delays to the operation of the system can be difficult. The authors wanted to verify what factors can affect the server's performance measured in queries execution time. The experiment concerned targeting selected query combinations in a series for various connection and server configurations.

articleTitle: The Use of IoT Technologies for the Monitoring of Electrotechnological Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 Conference on Electrotechnology: Processes, Models, Control and Computer Science (EPMCCS)
abstract: Nowadays it is noticed the rapid development of the Internet of Things technologies. They can be used for continuous monitoring of electrotechnological systems and their power supply networks. The work presents data exchange technologies used in IoT and the use of these methods in the monitoring system of electrotechnological processes.

articleTitle: Ti6Al7Nb Alloy Laser Micromachining-Surface Properties
publicationTitle: 2018 Conference on Electrotechnology: Processes, Models, Control and Computer Science (EPMCCS)
abstract: The paper presents results of the studies concerning Ti6Al7Nb titanium alloy surface laser machining. Due to its properties, the alloy is applied in medicine, among other things for hip joint endoprosthesis. Such application imposes special requirements as to surface condition. Laser TruMicro 5000 model 5325c was used for machining purposes that emits ultraviolet radiation (wavelength 343 nm) within picosecond pulses. Laser such as this is especially useful for creating surface structures (surface texture). It enables subtractive manufacturing using the ablation effect. The paper includes physical basics of laser micromachining, impact of gaseous shield, methodology of process parameters selection, change of a microstructure, microhardness and chemical composition within the machined zone. Moreover, laser surface texturing impact on corrosion resistance is studied. The result of this work is identification of micromachining parameters that ensure ablative process course and texture parameters that guarantee the most favourable utility properties.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Load Current Harmonics Content in a Series Resonant Inverter for Induction Heating Controlled Using Various Cases of the AVC Control Strategy
publicationTitle: 2018 Conference on Electrotechnology: Processes, Models, Control and Computer Science (EPMCCS)
abstract: Resonant inverters are widely applied in induction heating applications. A voltage-fed series resonant inverter (SRI) is frequently used as a reliable and cost-effective converter, providing various power control strategies. This paper analyses the load current harmonics content in an SRI for induction heating controlled using particular cases of the Asymmetrical Voltage-Cancellation (AVC) control strategy, belonging to fixed-frequency control techniques. The analysis is carried out for the inverter operation at the minimum values of frequencies guaranteeing zero-voltage switching, and at the fixed frequencies assuring power control in an assumed range of power. Moreover, the impact of the quality factor of the load circuit has been taken into account. The values of the total harmonic distortion (THD) of the load current occurring in Asymmetrical Duty-Cycle (ADC), Phase-Shift Control (PSC) and Asymmetrical Clamped Mode (ACM) control techniques have been determined and compared. The results of mathematical analysis are verified using MATLAB/Simulink simulations. This in-depth analysis and the results obtained are some novel contributions to the existing knowledge of the properties of the aforementioned control strategies of an SRI for induction heating.

publicationTitle: 2018 Conference on Electrotechnology: Processes, Models, Control and Computer Science (EPMCCS)
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: induction heating; finite element analysis; reactive power; power system harmonics; power supply quality; voltage control; steel; LED lamps; automotive engineering; temperature control.
